units.rawText: I don't mind.

spans.text: The Boss wanted to send you to the Oasis, but you pushed yourself...

units.rawText: You can drop the excuses, you just didn't want to work with Hatsuchiri.

units.rawText: Honestly, I can't believe you're still throwing tantrums about your big sister at such an age...

spans.text: I told you, my condition is stable already!

units.rawText: ... And don't forget that I was worse off when I was fighting in the Copley Sector.

units.rawText: (Sigh) That's why I'm worried about you. Everyone's like that. They overexert themselves so easily...

spans.text: (Sigh) That's why I'm worried about you. Everyone's like that. They overexert themselves so easily...
